# Hawiyat
> AI infrastructure platform — the execution layer between frontier AI models and business systems. Hawiyat AI Composer decides the best way to accomplish each task: which model to route to, what context to carry, and whether the result is good enough.

This optional file helps compatible non-Google systems discover Hawiyat's main public pages. Google Search does not use llms.txt as a ranking signal.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.hawiyat.org/): The execution layer between frontier AI models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, open models) and the systems businesses run — WhatsApp, CRM, ERP, email, databases, workflows.
- [Hawiyat AI Composer](https://www.hawiyat.org/composer): The AI execution engine — every task runs UNDERSTAND → PLAN → ROUTE → EXECUTE → EVALUATE → RESULT, model-agnostic, evaluated, and priced in DZD.
- [Services](https://www.hawiyat.org/services): Hawiyat AI Composer plans, pay-per-run AI Composer access, n8n hosting, Evolution API (WhatsApp infrastructure), and application hosting — all billed in Algerian dinars.
- [About Hawiyat](https://www.hawiyat.org/about): Company, team, credentials, and Algeria presence.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.hawiyat.org/terms): Legal terms for the Hawiyat platform and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hawiyat.org/privacy): How Hawiyat collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [DMCA](https://www.hawiyat.org/dmca): Copyright notice and counter-notice policy.

## Important facts
- Hawiyat is based in Algeria and supports customers in Arabic, French, and English.
- Billing is in Algerian dinars (DZD); local payment methods CCP and Baridi Mob are accepted.
- Models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, open models) are routes on the execution layer, never sold as SKUs or credits. Hawiyat does not resell or rebrand any model.
- Hawiyat does not imply an official partnership with any model provider unless explicitly stated; third-party product and model names belong to their respective owners.
